name: Chord Sequencer Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Chord and pattern presets for Chord Sequencer by music style: pop, ballad, cinematic, film score, ambient, trance, synthwave, lo-fi, neo-classical, deep house and funk & disco. Newer presets use per-step velocity and length, 1/32 and 1/64 rolls and recorded-note tracks. Every preset fills all four tracks (chords, bass, pulse, bells) in one key and all four scenes (main, variation, breakdown, lift).
